title: Velvety Sweet Thai Pork Curry
description: A sweet and indulgent Thai dish featuring tender pork and white sauerkraut in a rich and creamy curry sauce, simmered to perfection for a low-sodium friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sauerkraut and cook, covered, for an additional 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Stir in the chopped basil and serve hot over rice or noodles.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
